title: Missed early mobilisation and ICU-acquired weakness: a nested case-control study in a mixed intensive care unit
abstract: Objective: to estimate the association between missed mobilisation on eligible days and ICU-acquired weakness at discharge. Design: case-control study nested in the ICU clinical information system with matched controls. Results will follow analysis.
introduction: Trials show early mobilisation reduces weakness, but adherence to bundles is partial and observational associations are confounded by severity.
methods: Cases with MRC sum score below 48 at discharge, two matched controls each, exposure on eligible days, conditional logistic regression.
results: No data have been analysed yet.
discussion: The discussion will interpret the association in light of confounding and the trial evidence.
summary: Case-control report structure with results left empty.
